scenario: 今天 AI 搜索这条线的主题是评测本身靠不靠得住。有一篇发现，检索器越强，靠相关性标注判断能不能回答的捷径就越不准。另一篇指出，只看攻击成功率会掩盖 RAG 防御新引入的错误，还有一篇梳理了视觉文档检索的基准到底在考什么。方法上，DecisionRank 让单次打分的重排模型向生成式老师学排序，速度快了一个数量级；还有一篇拆开了 BERT cross-encoder 内部判断相关的步骤。

papers.title: Better Retrievers, Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG
papers.abstract: Conversational RAG benchmarks such as MTRAG and RETECO evaluate retrieval and generation end to end: each system answers from its own retrieval, so abstention must be scored against whether each retrieved context is sufficient. A convenient shortcut reads sufficiency off the relevance judgments and treats a context without gold documents as unanswerable. We re-run the official baselines exactly and test this shortcut on RECOR (RETECO track~2) with four retrievers (nDCG@10 from .18 to .59) and three Qwen3 readers. Two open LLM judges and a panel of four small open models label each context by content, and a model of another family audits 250 contexts blind, with adjudication. The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28\% to 72\%) and the lower the shortcut's precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit). A reader agrees: Qwen3-4B answers 62--67\% of these false misses correctly, against 23--30\% of no-gold contexts judged insufficient and 1\% with no documents. In most false misses, the answer comes from a hard negative mined for the same question, another turn's gold or a neighbouring chunk of the gold page. On MTRAG, whose judgments come from annotators, precision drops from .72 to .50. Under the shortcut, answerability AUROC is up to .19 too low, and the best sufficiency detector appears to be a retrieval score that never reads the documents. We release code, runs and labels, and recommend scoring refusals against content labels, not the presence of gold.
papers.summary: 对话式 RAG 评测里，判断检索内容够不够回答常走一条捷径：检索结果里没有标注过的相关文档，就算答不了，模型这时拒答算对。作者在 RECOR 上换了四个检索器重跑，发现检索器越强，这条捷径越不准：没有标注文档、其实却含有答案的上下文，从 28% 升到 72%。原因是相关性标注不全，强检索器常常找到没被标过的有用文档。用这条捷径打分，会奖励本该回答却拒答的模型。评测拒答时应该看检索内容本身，而不是看有没有命中标注文档。

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
papers.authors: Yanran Wu, Dian Yu, Chongyang Bai, Jieyi Zhang, Rui Liu, Tianyi Chen, Shike Mei, Hang Cui, Frank Shyu, Sandeep Pandey, Luke Simon, Chunwei Liu, Xi Liu
papers.abstract: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. Combined with offline ranking supervision, DecisionRank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT. Across four benchmarks, item-space OPD consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. Even at 1.7B parameters, DecisionRank surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19--23. At 8B, it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running $24.5\times$ faster on TREC DL and $16.7\times$ faster on BRIGHT.
papers.summary: 用大模型做 listwise 重排效果好，但要逐个生成文档编号，很慢。只看第一个 token 上各文档编号的分数、一次排完要快得多，难点是怎么把大模型老师的排序能力教给这种学生。DecisionRank 让学生先按自己的分数排出列表，老师在每一位上看：前面几位已经定了，剩下的文档里谁该排下一位，给出一个概率分布；学生在剩下文档上的分数也换算成分布去贴近它。结果 1.7B 的学生在 TREC DL 上超过了 27B 的老师，8B 学生在 TREC DL 上比同尺寸的生成式 listwise 重排更准，还快 24.5 倍。

deep_reading.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers

papers.title: How BERT-based Cross-Encoders Model Relevance in Information Retrieval?
papers.authors: Mathias Vast, Basile Van Cooten, Laure Soulier, Benjamin Piwowarski
papers.abstract: Cross-encoders are the most effective but also the least efficient models in Information Retrieval. Despite their success, the mechanisms underlying their relevance predictions remain poorly understood, particularly how they process to match queries and documents. This lack of interpretability limits their optimization, can lead to suboptimal retrieval, especially out-of-domain, and raises efficiency concerns for over-parameterized models. To address these challenges, this paper investigates two under-explored aspects of cross-encoder behavior. First, to understand the relevance prediction process, we trace the flow of information at the different stages of the process and between different input segments. We study the nature of the signals that compose this flow and that allow cross-encoders to predict the relevance of a passage to a query. Our work particularly focuses on the matching performed by the cross-encoders between queries and documents. Second, we explore how cross-encoders behave with out-of-domain documents and/or queries. Through a series of interpretability experiments, we evaluate three BERT-based cross-encoder models, varying in size and pre-training strategies, across both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets. Overall, this study both consolidates what is known about how cross-encoders model relevance and extends it by exploring the role of matching signals.
papers.summary: 基于 BERT 的 cross-encoder 是最准的重排模型之一，但它内部怎么判断相关一直说不清。论文在三个大小不同的模型、多个域内和域外数据集上追踪信息怎么流动，发现三个模型走的是同样的几个阶段：前中层先让 token 结合上下文，同时有专门的注意力头找 query 和文档之间的字面匹配；更深的层出现找语义匹配的头；最后这些信号汇到 query 的 token 和 [CLS] 上打分。细节则各不相同：三个模型把相关信号汇进 [CLS] 的方式不一样，MiniLM 甚至可能是在找“不相关”的证据。

deep_reading.title: How BERT-based Cross-Encoders Model Relevance in Information Retrieval?

papers.title: ProSearch: Benchmarking Multi-Constraint Protocol Retrieval in Experimental Science
papers.authors: Wenliang Liang, Zhiyuan Ning, Haolin Chen, Yuanchun Zhou, Wenjuan Cui, Yi Du
papers.abstract: In AI for Science scenarios, experimental design and method reproduction require retrieving protocols that satisfy multiple interdependent constraints, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of this capability. To address this gap, we introduce ProSearch, a benchmark for multi-constraint protocol retrieval in experimental science. ProSearch has three key features: (1) realism, with queries grounded in real experimental records and expert-defined templates; (2) complexity, with 60 experimental fields and their dependencies; and (3) diagnosticity, with 3-5 explicit constraints per query, including numerical and negation constraints. We construct ProSearch through LLM-based extraction, data-driven constraint selection, controlled query generation, and evidence-based relevance validation. The resulting benchmark contains 1,515 queries across six experimental science domains. We conduct extensive experiments on ProSearch with 19 representative retrievers and complementary analyses. The best-performing retriever achieves an average nDCG@10 of only 0.290, which improves to 0.474 with reranking. Structured diagnostic analysis shows that explicit constraint matching provides a strong ranking signal, while manual error analysis identifies joint constraint binding as a key bottleneck. ProSearch provides a testbed for systematically evaluating scientific retrieval systems.
papers.summary: 研究者找实验步骤时，往往同时带着好几个条件，比如某种细胞要在特定温度下培养，但不能用 DMEM 培养基；而一段方法描述里常常并列写着几套实验方案，所有条件必须落在同一套方案上才算找对。ProSearch 把这类需求做成覆盖六个实验科学领域的检索评测。19 个检索器里最好的 nDCG@10 只有 0.290，加上重排也只到 0.474。人工错误分析发现，排在前面的错误结果里九成至少有一个条件不满足。

papers.title: Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings
papers.abstract: Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. To test whether this regularity is usable, we introduce PEEL (Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies): a minimal probe over these frozen embeddings, trained once with an order-embedding objective that represents hierarchy as vector containment; a minimum spanning arborescence then decodes taxonomic DAGs. Using only a concept vocabulary (no documents), PEEL recovers taxonomic DAGs with high structural fidelity on two OLLM benchmarks, transferring to a new domain with no target-edge supervision. The end-to-end OLLM pipeline, which jointly discovers concepts and induces structure from document corpora, is reported as a cross-task reference. Pre-trained retrieval embeddings encode a decodable granularity gradient; a minimal probe renders it as explicit parent-child (is-a) structure.
papers.summary: 现成的检索 embedding 里带着能读出来的分类树信息。作者发现，用 Matryoshka 训练（MRL）的 embedding 把分类信息主要放在靠前的维度：按原顺序截取前一小段，比打乱后截取或截取末尾更能把同类概念聚到一起。PEEL 据此在冻结的 embedding 上只训一个 9.8 万参数的小投影，学会从两个概念的向量判断谁是上位，再拼成分类图。把拼出的图和标准分类图的节点一一配对，按节点名字和邻居的相似程度打分（Graph F1，满分 1），它在 Wikipedia 和 arXiv 上得到 0.885 和 0.931，前提是给定完整概念词表和一份标准上下位边。

papers.title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is vulnerable to knowledge poisoning, where adversaries manipulate retrieved evidence to influence model outputs. Existing defenses are primarily evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which obscures defense-induced failures and the mechanisms behind apparent attack prevention. To address this issue, this work introduces \textbf{Aligned RAG Evaluation}, a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses, with and without defense. By combining matched conditions analysis, LLM-judge endorsement, and retrieval dependence controls, the proposed framework distinguishes prevented from introduced failures, target mentions from LLM endorsement, and single-passage influence from evidence composition. Experiments on HotpotQA and Natural Questions reveal that existing defenses can introduce unexpected target-positive answers, although they can prevent some attacks, while evaluation criteria can also change defense rankings. Our findings expose critical blind spots in ASR-based evaluation and motivate a more comprehensive assessment of RAG poisoning defenses. The code and the evaluation artifact are available at https://github.com/chxhana/aligned-rag-eval.
papers.summary: RAG 投毒防御通常只用一个数评估：加了防御后，攻击成功率降了多少。攻击成功率指模型被投毒文档带着说出攻击者答案的比例。作者把每个 query 在四种情况下的回答都存下来，即干净检索和投毒检索各自开关防御，再逐条对比。结果发现，防御挡掉一部分攻击的同时，会让另一些原本没被骗的 query 反而说出攻击者的答案，只看成功率会把这部分抵消掉。基于检索分数的检测器也有盲区：上下文里只有一篇投毒文档时，60 个中招回答它拦下 59 个；投毒文档有五篇时，一个也拦不住。评估防御要同时报告它挡掉了什么、新引入了什么。

papers.title: Pix2Evidence: A Multimodal RAG System for Text and Visual Evidence
papers.authors: Ziniu Liu, Xiaoyang Chen, Dezhi Ye, Jie Liu, Jin Ma, Hao Deng
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over visually rich documents must find both relevant content and the evidence that supports an answer. Screenshot retrieval preserves images and page structure, but written facts within screenshots also need to be searchable. Moreover, topical relevance alone does not identify which retrieved tile contains evidence for the answer. We introduce Pix2Evidence, a multimodal RAG system that encodes each screenshot tile together with its available transcription into a single fused image--text representation, so that layout and readable text are considered jointly during retrieval. To guide evidence selection, a vision-language teacher describes the visible content that supports each training question. We use these descriptions to adapt the retriever, then rerank the retrieved candidates before answer generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Pix2Evidence outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Across five widely-used Wikipedia QA benchmarks, the non-reranked Pix2Evidence leads the main comparison in answer accuracy on four. On MMSearch, it reaches 26.0\%, 4.4 percentage points above PixelRAG. We will release the code and share derived data where licensing and privacy reviews permit.
papers.summary: 用网页截图做 RAG 能保留图片和版面，但截图里的名字、日期、数字这类文字事实不容易被检索到。Pix2Evidence 把每块截图和它的文字转录一起编码成一个向量，让版面和文字在检索时一起起作用。训练时，一个视觉语言模型先为每道训练题写一段话，描述截图里支撑答案的内容；检索器除了常规的对比学习，还要让问题检索出的截图排序和这段描述检索出的排序保持一致。不加重排时，它在五个 Wikipedia 问答基准中的四个上，答题准确率高于文本抽取和只检索截图的对比方法；在 MMSearch 上达到 26.0%，比只检索截图的 PixelRAG 高 4.4 个百分点。

papers.title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
papers.authors: Minhao Sun, Zhijing Wu, Xian-Ling Mao
papers.abstract: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.
papers.summary: agent 搜索每步都要选：往下推，还是先去搜。只按最终答案对错给奖励，分不清错在搜索选择还是检索和推理。这篇论文给每步单独打分。模型把这一步的中间结论重写几遍，算出这些 token 的平均负对数似然作为不确定度，再用训练前拟合的一条曲线换算成答对概率，即可靠度。不搜的步骤，得分是可靠度减去校准集上的平均可靠度；搜了的步骤，用同一个搜索词，带上和去掉搜回的段落各重写几遍结论，可靠度涨了多少就得多少分。用 GRPO 训练后，在七个问答基准上，平均 CEM（标准答案是否出现在回答里）比 HiPRAG 高 2.1 分，搜索次数少 6.8%。

papers.title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
papers.authors: Zhichang Yu, Baining Cao, Sbaaoui Idriss, Qi Wang, Gangqiang Xu, Ling Qin, Xiaoling Jin, An Liu, Shaohao Cai, Xiaoyang Bao, Shengle Chen, Changchang Ding, Pengfei Zhu, Jingxiang Xu, Yifeng Mao, Lu Liu, Hai Jin, Yingfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. It is a supply layer. A navigation tree whose leaves are claim-evidence pairs--the mechanism we measure--cuts query tokens by 91% when evidence suffices and adds 1.9% when it does not, a 38% average reduction; this implies a 2% break-even sufficiency rate and a measured rate near 43%. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution's token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Other artifacts--ontology, graph, wiki, timeline, mind map, memory--pay off in deployment (governance, integration, onboarding, temporal orientation, continuity) where accuracy benchmarks cannot see them. We describe RAGFlow's pipeline and harness (open source at https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow), which turns the loop into five disciplined stations and keeps the context entering the model the smallest sufficient set; together they form an agent-native database: a store that hands the agent compiled, governed context instead of a ranked list of passages.
papers.summary: 只用 BM25 和关键词查找当检索工具，配上会自己改写 query、决定何时停下的搜索循环，大模型就能答对 BrowseComp-Plus 里 85% 的题。作者认为准确率已经不是主要问题，问题出在上下文：循环会重复搜同样的词、反复读同样的文档，把上下文窗口塞满用不上的段落。RAGFlow 的办法是入库时先用大模型把文档拆成一条条断言，每条带着原文证据句。搜索时先查这些断言，判断环节认为证据够用，就只读这几句，不再读整段原文。和直接读原文段落的同一套搜索循环相比，证据够用时，单个查询的总 token 少 91%，不够用时只多 1.9%，在 FRAMES 上平均省 38%。图谱、百科页这类结构对准确率没有可测的提升。

papers.title: Defining Page-Centric Visual Document Retrieval and Evaluating Existing Benchmarks
papers.authors: Chongzhi Zhang, Yuqi Zuo, Aixin Sun
papers.abstract: In modern information retrieval (IR), documents are increasingly encountered as structured sequences of visually rich, paginated units, rather than as flat text. Example documents encountered in our daily life include Word files, PDFs, and slide decks. Free text-centric retrieval systems either ignore this structure entirely or destroy it through arbitrary passage chunking. In this paper, we formulate page-centric Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) with pages as the fundamental indexing units and document context available for assessing page relevance. The formulation distinguishes two retrieval granularities, page and document, and three retrieval paradigms: independent-item, evidence-set, and iterative retrieval. We then assess 42 benchmarks using eight criteria covering corpus characteristics, query construction, relevance annotation, and ranking support. Our analysis shows two main findings on current VDR research. First, evaluation remains concentrated on page-level independent-item retrieval, with fewer resources supporting document-level, evidence-set, and iterative settings. Second, queries originating from real user information needs independently of target corpus content and graded relevance judgments are uncommon, while the coverage and verification of relevance judgments vary substantially. Both findings reveal gaps between the capabilities applications require and those existing evaluation protocols can establish. We provide benchmark selection guidance and identify priorities for future benchmark design, emphasizing alignment between task requirements, relevance semantics, and evaluation protocols.
papers.summary: Word、PDF、幻灯片这类文档都是按页组织的，但现有的视觉文档检索评测大多只考一件事：给一个问题，找出单独的一页。这篇论文先把这类检索按两种粒度分开，即找页还是找整份文档，再按三种方式分开，即逐条找、找一组合起来才构成证据的页、多轮迭代地找；然后用八条标准检查了 42 个现有基准。多数基准只覆盖单页逐条找；来自真实用户需求的问题和分等级的相关性标注都很少，标注有没有覆盖全库也差别很大。选基准时要先确认它测的是不是应用真正需要的能力。
